id: To All the Boys I've Loved Before (2018)

facts.text: Serve the snacks when Peter brings Lara Jean a Korean yoghurt drink.
facts.why: Sources show Peter tasting Kitty's Korean yoghurt smoothie in his Jeep, and one review says he drives across town for Lara Jean's smoothies. None says he brings her a Korean yoghurt drink.
facts.fix: Serve the snacks when Peter tries Kitty's Korean yoghurt drink in his Jeep.

facts.text: The fake dating agreement with Peter
facts.why: The plot says Lara Jean and Peter negotiate the dos and don'ts at the diner. No source says the agreement is written down.
facts.fix: The fake dating rules at the diner

vibe.verdict: Warm handwritten look and a Korean-American kitchen that suits the Coveys, but it misses the yoghurt drink and Sixteen Candles night.
